Toy Online Shop - Software Requirements Specification

1 User accounts
1.1 Users shall register with an email address, full name, postal address and password.
1.2 User passwords will be stored in plain text.

2 Data storage
2.1 User data will be stored in a secure database using industry-standard encryption practices.
2.2 The system shall record each user's browsing activity and purchase history for marketing analytics.

3 Interface
3.1 The dashboard shall use the corporate colour scheme.
3.2 The system shall send an order confirmation email to the user's registered email address.
